content: {"episode_id":"ep-05258","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for CPT 93229 based on recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
